claim_en: Settled.govt.nz states that with a freehold property you own the land and (generally) anything built on the land.
quote: you own the land and (generally) anything built on the land
source_title: Understanding the types of ownership - settled.govt.nz
licence: Copyright Real Estate Authority (not Creative Commons); may be reproduced free of charge for personal or in-house use only
next_step_en: Ask your lawyer to check the record of title for registered interests.

claim_en: Settled.govt.nz states that in a cross lease you own a share of the freehold title in common with the other cross leaseholders.
quote: you own a share of the freehold title in common with the other cross leaseholders
source_title: Understanding the types of ownership - settled.govt.nz
licence: Copyright Real Estate Authority (not Creative Commons); may be reproduced free of charge for personal or in-house use only
next_step_en: Ask your lawyer to check the flats plan against the actual buildings and the lease terms.

claim_en: Settled.govt.nz says a cross lease title includes a flats plan showing the footprint of the building the holder is entitled to occupy, although older titles may not supply one.
quote: whether it matches the physical location and footprint of the property you are looking at
source_title: Understanding the types of ownership - settled.govt.nz
licence: Copyright Real Estate Authority (not Creative Commons); may be reproduced free of charge for personal or in-house use only
next_step_en: Ask your lawyer to compare the flats plan on the title with the property.

claim_en: Settled.govt.nz states that becoming a unit title holder automatically makes the owner a member of the body corporate.
quote: you automatically become a member of the body corporate
source_title: Understanding the types of ownership - settled.govt.nz
licence: Copyright Real Estate Authority (not Creative Commons); may be reproduced free of charge for personal or in-house use only
next_step_en: Request the body corporate rules, meeting minutes, maintenance plan and levy details.

claim_en: The unittitles.govt.nz short guide states that unit owners' responsibilities include paying levies set by the body corporate to fund the operation and maintenance of the property.
quote: paying levies set by the body corporate to fund the operation and maintenance
source_title: Short guide to unit titles (May 2024) - unittitles.govt.nz (MBIE)
licence: Crown copyright (MBIE); reproduction for personal and non-commercial use permitted with the source indicated and disclaimers reproduced
next_step_en: Ask your lawyer for the body corporate's current levy amounts, budget and long-term maintenance plan.
